first: Great to hear! How's the data looking after the cleanup? If anything came up during the review pass — unexpected park names, phone number patterns, or duplicate edge cases — I'm happy to help you work through them or build out that summary tab.

turns.user:
Good — next I need a Summary tab. Can you give me:
1) Formulas (or a pivot setup) to show counts: Total rows, REVIEW rows, OK rows, DUP-email, DUP-name-time, and counts per Canonical park.
2) A formula to count unique volunteers after deduping (keep latest per email; if no email, treat name as identifier).
3) A small Apps Script that will automatically mark the SUPERSEDED column by keeping the latest submission per email.

Paste those three things — start with the summary formulas so I can drop them into a new sheet.

Nice — can you update the Apps Script to do this before I run it?

Requirements:
- Build volunteer key = email if present else name (use lowercase trimmed email, else lowercase trimmed name).
- Ignore rows where Clean!P = "REVIEW" (don’t mark those as SUPERSEDED).
- For each volunteer key with >1 non-REVIEW rows, keep the row with the latest parsed timestamp (column I) and mark the others SUPERSEDED in column O; leave the kept row blank in O.
- Still don’t touch rows that have blank keys (no email and no name) — leave them for manual review.
- After that, give me a one-line replacement formula for Unique Volunteers that counts distinct volunteer keys among rows where P<>"REVIEW" and O<>"SUPERSEDED".

Also paste the modified script only (no extra explanation).

Can you tweak the script two ways before I run it?

1) If a row's timestamp (col I) is blank or not a date, treat it as older than any real date so rows with real dates win.
2) If two rows have the exact same timestamp, keep the one that appears later in the sheet (higher row index).

Also instead of the UI alert, have it write two numbers on the Summary sheet: cell B16 = number of keys processed (groups with >1 non-REVIEW rows) and B17 = number of rows marked SUPERSEDED.

Just paste the modified script only.

Two quick tweaks before I run it:

1) Can you modify the script so it first clears column O for all rows 2: last (so old SUPERSEDED marks are removed), then writes the new flags?  
2) Also make it create Summary!B18 = total non-REVIEW rows scanned (for sanity checking).

Just paste the updated script when ready.

Nice — one more tiny tweak before I run it: can you modify the script to also write the current timestamp into Summary!B19 (when the script finished), using the sheet's timezone? Paste just the updated script.

turns.text: Glad it all came together. If you need anything else down the line — a chart on the Summary tab, an export-ready filtered view, or a trigger to run the script automatically when new responses come in — just let me know.
